title: Easy Wool
body:
Tired of the noisy, high-detail look of vanilla wool? 🧶 Easy Wool simplifies the texture to give it a cleaner, smoother, and more visually relaxing appearance. Perfect for builders who want their creations to look crisp without the visual clutter!

Features:
✨ Simplified, smooth wool texture
🎨 Maintains the original color palette
🕊️ Clean and builder-friendly look

Compatibility:
Works with all wool colors and blocks. Just drop it in your resourcepacks folder and enjoy!
